deals.travelWindow: Dec 13 ($63 one-way) through Jan 24 ($52); Feb 6–8 from $44–62 sits right at the 3-month edge
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $52 (Jan 24) and $63 (Dec 13), about $104–140 round trip; still the cheapest BOS fare, with Everglades NP ~1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and beach strip, a cheap water taxi, and easy day trips without a long drive.

highlights: Fort Lauderdale Beach promenade and Las Olas Boulevard
Water taxi along the Intracoastal and New River
Shark Valley tram and bike loop in Everglades NP
Hugh Taylor Birch State Park for a quiet beach-side walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, walk Las Olas, sunset water taxi to the beach
Day 2 — Early Shark Valley tram or bike loop in Everglades NP (rent a car or book a tour)
Day 3 — Hugh Taylor Birch State Park walk, brunch, fly home
guide.gettingAround: Water taxi and Brightline cover the core; a rental car only matters for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Near Las Olas or the beach, walkable to food and the water taxi.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $61 (Dec 13), about $122–170 round trip; Great Smoky Mountains NP is ~45 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact downtown, a free trolley, and Smokies day trips are simple with a rental car.

highlights: Great Smoky Mountains NP: Gatlinburg entrance and Laurel Falls
Market Square and Old City downtown
Urban Wilderness trails south of the river
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Old City evening, Sunsphere view
Day 2 — Smokies: Laurel Falls trail and the Newfound Gap road (check winter road closures)
Day 3 — Ijams or Urban Wilderness trails, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with a free trolley; rent a car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square for walkable food and nightlife.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $66 (Dec 31), about $132–185 round trip; now cheaper than Des Moines, with Sleeping Bear Dunes within a car trip.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown with a strong brewery and coffee scene and a short drive to the lakeshore.

itinerary: Day 3 — Lake Michigan day trip, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; rent a car for the lakeshore.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 20 ($74 one-way) and Nov 13 ($82), Allegiant; fares jump after Nov 23
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $74 (Nov 20), about $148–200 round trip; price rose from yesterday, no national park nearby but an easy solo city break.
deals.soloWhy: Small, safe downtown with free museums and connected skywalks for cold weather.

itinerary: Day 2 — Sculpture Park and Art Center
Day 3 — Botanical Garden, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; a rideshare covers the Art Center.

deals.travelWindow: Dec 17 and Dec 31 ($87 one-way), Allegiant; Feb 19–22 from $56–67 is beyond 3 months
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $87 (Dec 17), about $174–230 round trip; Blue Ridge Parkway is 15 min away and the Smokies 1 h 15 min.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown, hostels, and an easy mix of trails and cafes.

itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown and River Arts District
Day 2 — Parkway drive and Craggy Gardens
Day 3 — Biltmore or a Smokies trip, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; a rental car opens up the Parkway.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the River Arts District.
